_comment: Per-entry review of formula.herb_drug_interactions_en. Hand-authored — this is a judgement about each statement, not derived data, so it is NOT generated by a script. text_sha1 pins the verdict to the exact wording reviewed: edit the statement and the validator reports it unreviewed again. Renderer contract: only entries with render_eligible=true may ever reach the screen.
reviewer: Fable (routing) — clinical wording and final render decision belong to Ting

verdicts.HOLD_UNSOURCED_BENEFIT: Benefit-direction claim with no statement-level source. Card-level source_urls point at vendor/aggregator front pages, not at this claim.
verdicts.HOLD_REVERSES_INTENDED_DRUG_EFFECT: Claims to undo an effect the prescriber wants. Acting on it can defeat the treatment.
verdicts.HOLD_MASKS_WARNING_SIGN: The symptom described is a warning sign that should reach the prescriber. Treating it can hide deterioration.
verdicts.HOLD_PRECLINICAL_AS_CLINICAL: Animal or in-vitro finding phrased as if it applied to patients.
verdicts.RISK_DIRECTION_KEEP: States a hazard rather than a benefit. Keep; needs sourcing and stronger wording, not removal.

formula.xiao_chai_hu_tang#0.note: 2026-08-12 升級:措辭從「maybe associated」改為併用禁忌,掛上 PubMed 8980988 / 7575138 與 LiverTox NBK548777。組成七味與日本 TJ-9 相同,故日方藥物警戒適用(查證過,非推論)。本庫唯一允許進畫面的交互作用敘述 —— 它講的是危害,其餘 25 段講的是效益且無來源。原句保留在該卡的 superseded_statements。

formula.you_gui_wan#0.note: 'Reversing corticosteroid-induced immune suppression' — for transplant and autoimmune patients that suppression IS the therapeutic goal. Highest-risk framing in the set.

formula.xiao_qing_long_tang#0.note: Names inhaled fluticasone in severe asthma. Read as permission to lean on the formula, it invites controller-inhaler reduction — the classic route to a fatal attack.

formula.da_chai_hu_tang#0.note: Aspirin/ethanol gastric haemorrhage is an emergency and a reason to stop the drug, not to add a formula. Comparing itself to sucralfate and cimetidine reads as a substitute for medical care.

formula.zuo_jin_wan#0.note: Same hazard as da_chai_hu_tang#0, milder wording ('protective effect against aspirin-induced damage').

formula.xiao_cheng_qi_tang#0.note: Opioid-induced constipation with nausea can mark bowel obstruction. 小承氣湯 is a purgative; using it against an obstruction is dangerous.

formula.ma_zi_ren_wan#0.note: Antipsychotic-induced constipation. Lower acuity than the opioid case but the same pattern: treat the side effect, do not tell the prescriber.

formula.shen_qi_wan#0.note: Long-term prednisone: the listed effects (weight gain, sweating, mood change) are the monitoring signals for Cushingoid change and adrenal suppression.

formula.xiao_chai_hu_tang#1.note: Explicitly murine renal cell carcinoma, placed in a field a clinician reads for patient decisions.

formula.xiao_chai_hu_tang#2.note: Synergy with AZT / 3TC. Antiretroviral co-prescribing is not something an unsourced sentence may assert.

formula.xiao_chai_hu_tang#4.note: Hepatoprotection against halothane / danazol / D-galactosamine / CCl4. The last two are laboratory hepatotoxins — preclinical work wearing clinical clothes. Sits on the card whose real signal is pneumonitis.

formula.jia_wei_xiao_yao_san#0.note: Antipsychotic-induced parkinsonism. Tardive syndromes need drug review, and 'reduce tremors' can delay that.

formula.jia_wei_xiao_yao_san#1.note: GnRH-agonist menopausal symptoms 'without a negative effect on serum estradiol'. A hormone-level claim needs a citation; three cards repeat this sentence nearly verbatim (see tao_he_cheng_qi_tang#0, dang_gui_shao_yao_san#1, shao_yao_gan_cao_tang#2) — one scraped paragraph spread across four formulas.

formula.tao_he_cheng_qi_tang#0.note: Same GnRH sentence as jia_wei_xiao_yao_san#1, reworded. 'Recommended for' is the strongest verb in the whole field and has nothing behind it.

formula.dang_gui_shao_yao_san#1.note: Same GnRH sentence again. Card is a skeleton with source_urls: [].

formula.shao_yao_gan_cao_tang#2.note: Fourth copy of the GnRH sentence. Card is a skeleton with source_urls: [].

formula.dang_gui_shao_yao_san#0.note: Colchicine-induced learning-acquisition deficit is a rodent memory model. Also carries a scrape typo ('induced bu colchicine'), which is how it entered.

formula.shao_yao_gan_cao_tang#0.note: Neuroleptic-induced hyperprolactinaemia in schizophrenia. Skeleton card, no sources; psychiatric co-management claim.

formula.shao_yao_gan_cao_tang#1.note: Paclitaxel myalgia/arthralgia. Plausible and studied in the literature, but this card cites nothing.

formula.wen_jing_tang#0.note: 'Potentiate clomiphene citrate' — potentiating an ovulation induction agent is a dose-safety claim (OHSS, multiple pregnancy), not a gentle one.

formula.bao_he_wan#0.note: Chemotherapy-induced nausea. 'With modifications' names no modifications, so it cannot be acted on even if true.

formula.zhi_bai_di_huang_wan#0.note: The only public_safe:true card in the field. Streptomycin toxicity is ototoxicity/nephrotoxicity — irreversible and requiring drug-level monitoring. Highest exposure combined with a serious subject.

formula.mai_men_dong_tang#0.note: ACE-inhibitor cough. The standard management is to switch the drug; a formula that suppresses the cough keeps the patient on it.

formula.mai_men_dong_tang#1.note: Capsaicin-induced cough is an experimental challenge model, not a clinical condition. Typo 'capsaicinl' marks the scrape.

formula.wu_ling_san#0.note: SSRI nausea. Lowest-acuity entry in the set; still unsourced.
